missing_secrets.description: Site slugs whose env file (/run/falak/env) or container secret files (/run/falak/secrets) are gone, usually because a reboot emptied the tmpfs. The control plane answers with site.env.write. Sent with every heartbeat until restored; omitted when empty.

databases.description: Database containers on the server (label falak.db.instance), every heartbeat; omitted when there are none. secrets_missing: the instance's password file is gone (a reboot emptied /run/falak/secrets) and its container cannot start; the control plane answers with db.instance.secrets.

facts.description: Only sent when changed since last heartbeat
